title: Shakespeare in Delaware Park

services.name: Program Advertising
services.desc: Now is the time for you to support our charitable mission and get your message in front of over 50,000 people in the Buffalo-Niagara region. By purchasing an online program ad this season, you will be supporting one of the area’s most widely attended cultural events and one of the largest FREE Shakespeare festivals in the country. As an added bonus, we will highlight your business logo on our season sponsorship banner - prominently displayed banner on Shakespeare Hill in Delaware Park. Your ad in the Shakespeare in Delaware Park’s season programs creates awareness of your business, brings customers in your door, and enhances your image as a community supporter. blurb: 2026 was not without its challenges. Mother Nature was certainly not kind to us at the beginning of the season, bringing rain, heat, and even smoke! But, as always, when the weather cooperated, you ALL showed up as a community with enthusiasm and a love of Shakespeare that has kept SDP going year after year.
